credential_fields.label: Services ID (client_id)
credential_fields.tip: In Apple Developer → Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles → Identifiers → Services IDs, create one and enable "Sign in with Apple". Use its identifier (e.g. com.yourco.app.web) here.

credential_fields.label: Team ID
credential_fields.tip: Your 10-character Apple Developer Team ID — shown at the top-right of the Apple Developer account page under Membership details.

credential_fields.label: Key ID
credential_fields.tip: In Apple Developer → Keys, create a key with "Sign in with Apple" enabled. The Key ID is shown on the key's page.

credential_fields.label: Private Key (.p8 contents)
credential_fields.tip: Open the .p8 file you downloaded when creating the Sign-in-with-Apple key and paste its entire contents, including the BEGIN and END lines. Apple lets you download this file only once.

requires: Apple Services ID, Team ID, Key ID and a .p8 Sign-in-with-Apple private key
setup_hint: Create a Services ID, enable Sign in with Apple, add this app's domain and the exact Return URL (Redirect URI) below, then create a Sign-in-with-Apple key and paste its Key ID + .p8 contents.
